_note: PLACEHOLDER measurements. Replace with the real rig. Units: mm and degrees. Table frame: origin at the front-left corner of the table top's footprint, x along the width (to the right), y along the depth (away from the front edge), z up from the floor. Angles are counter-clockwise seen from above, 0 = +x. Zones and bags give the centre (x, y) and size of a rectangle.

arm._angles: arm.angle is the servo angle: 0 points right, 180 points left, sweeping across the front. Heading of the stick in the table frame = heading_at_zero + direction * angle. height is the stick's height above the table top.
